referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Glint Dental website in Austin, Texas uses a muted cinematic city image with very large warm-white type. Navigation is small cream navigation with one rounded booking control. Its page moves through cinematic opening, editorial proposition, photographic treatment tiles, clinician portrait feature, patient story strip, technology explanation, review carousel, contact close, with four large photographic treatment choices with short supporting labels. warm treatment and clinician photography with generous rounded crops. Transferable mechanics are cinematic cream hero, warm photographic treatment tiles, rust clinician chapter. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
